title: DSAP: Analyzing Bias Through Demographic Comparison of Datasets
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The proposed methodology, DSAP, is designed to analyze and compare demographic bias in datasets, focusing on attributes like age, gender, and race as predicted by an auxiliary computer vision model from facial images.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The word 'religion' is mentioned a single time as an example of a protected demographic attribute, but it is not included in the paper's analysis, which is confined to age, gender, and race.
